entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nabi Bakhsh Khan Baloch was a Balochi research scholar, historian, Sindhologist, educationist, linguist and writer from Pakistan. He predominantly wrote in Sindhi, but also in Urdu, English, Persian and Arabic. He has been described as the "moving library" of the Pakistani province of Sindh.
